sources.title: Warhounds on Steam
sources.version_boundary: English Steam listing observed after the August 11, 2026 release

claims.statement: Warhounds combines turn-based tactical battles with a strategic layer where the player commands a private military company.
The five named classes are Assault, Specialist, Sniper, Machine Gunner, and Grenadier.
Base management includes recruitment, upgrading soldiers, buying equipment, logistics, finances, medical care, downtime, faction relationships, intelligence, and covert operations.
Official combat features include lines of fire, destructible cover, high ground, true ballistics, drones, scanners, smoke, optical camouflage, and cone-based overwatch.
Campaign choices can change missions, available gear, and allied support.

unknowns: The current sources do not publish a complete tutorial sequence or exact first-hour upgrade order.
Exact economy formulas, weapon damage values, and hidden difficulty scaling are not established here.
Recommendations in the guide are strategic inferences from confirmed systems, not claims about a single mandatory build.
